Compare two candidate records in sequence. Both must meet 78; higher primary score wins, and equal primary scores are broken by the earlier timestamp. The first record maps to Quartz; the second maps to Flint. Read the mapping literally and retain the exact capitalization of the two possible ledger words. The first unrelated thread concerns scanner lamp replacement: its count was copied from yesterday and will be checked separately. That inventory neither changes a predicate nor selects a classification label.

The operations margin also records who will perform each follow-up and which worksheet will receive the confirmation. Those notes make the conversation realistically interleaved, yet they do not add a criterion, change a comparison, or create an exception.
